title: ClinicalTrials.gov condition search extraction
description: Search ClinicalTrials.gov for studies matching a condition and posting-date range, then extract seven key fields verbatim from each study's own rendered page (never from the API) into a single spreadsheet — with a full provenance audit trail so no value can be silently fabricated or backfilled.

cta.label: Fork and run
cta.note: Runs on Jetty's managed sandbox. No setup. Free for your first 10 runs.

inputs.label: Condition
inputs.description: Exact condition text to search for on ClinicalTrials.gov. Used verbatim — no synonym substitution.

inputs.label: Posted from
inputs.description: Earliest 'First Posted' date to include (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD.

inputs.label: Posted to
inputs.description: Latest 'First Posted' date to include (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD.

metrics._note: Live counters — supplied by the Jetty backend at render time, not authored here.

caveats: Every field except Study URL is read from the study's own rendered ClinicalTrials.gov page, not the API — the API is only used to build the candidate NCT list, so values reflect the page exactly as displayed (including estimated/actual qualifiers), which can occasionally diverge from the API's structured fields.
ClinicalTrials.gov study pages are client-rendered (JS SPA) — this runbook requires a real browser (Playwright/Chromium), not a plain HTTP fetch.

Re-running the multiple-myeloma example one week after the original 2026-08-25 run reproduced the same 46 studies; 2 cells had genuinely changed on ClinicalTrials.gov (a status moving to Recruiting, a start date becoming Actual) and 2 Study Type cells differed only in whether the page's '[Patient Registry]' qualifier was copied. The CSV reflects the rendered page at run time, and extraction_audit.json is what lets you check which.
